h: Omo-Agege warns election riggers in 2027 will face serious consequences
p: Former Deputy Senate President Ovie Omo-Agege, now seeking a Senate seat on the NDC platform, has reportedly warned that anyone who rigs the 2027 elections will face grave consequences. His wording has drawn comment online, with some reading it as a threat and others as a warning about public anger.
more: He is running under the NDC banner.
INEC has repeatedly promised credible polls.
Critics have asked him to clarify what he meant.
